title: The Critical Spin Field of the Planar XY Model
main_claim: At the mass-defined critical inverse temperature b_c of the nearest-neighbour XY model, take the spin field on [-1,1]^2 with zero boundary angles. Normalise it by the exact center magnetization a_n and the lattice Green factor exp{(G_n(x,x)-G_n(0,0))/(2K*)}, with K*=2/pi. This field converges in law in H^{-3}_loc to the full-variance imaginary chaos exp(i Phi_D/sqrt(K*)) of the Dirichlet GFF. All mixed moments, including nonneutral ones, also converge. Two inputs come from companion paper C: a(b_c)=8pi and the fixed-geometry height and pin limits.

issues.description: This is not a gap in the argument. The result depends on cited companion results that this audit did not check. From [C]: the critical coefficient a(b_c)=8pi, the free and mixed height limits, and the separated-pin determinant limit. From [B]: the lattice-Gaussian covariance comparison (Lemma 2.1) and the off-diagonal convergence of the killed Green function (Lemma 4.2). Every constant that flows through K*=a/(4pi^2) depends on a(b_c)=8pi.
issues.evidence: 'the critical coefficient there is a(b_c)=8pi, giving K_*=a(b_c)/(4pi^2)'; 'The covariance under the numerator law dominates that under the centered denominator law; see [B, Lemma 2.1]'

coverage:
I read all seven sections in full (main.tex and sections 01-07) and checked the following.
- Sector upper bound: the dual divergence-free tilt bound and its optimum -||P dv0||^2/(2a).
- Normalisation consistency: Var<h,Ag> = a∫|∇g|^2 matches the Gaussian density exp(-(1/2a)∫|∇h|^2).
- Unit-winding energy 2pi log(lambda), giving the exponent pi/a = 1/8.
- Patch-loss identity (6) and the restoration identity F_open = (F_cut - L_s)/(1 - L_0), verified algebraically.
- Localization lemma: the singular-value bound s_j <= C N_d/j, giving HS^2 <= C N_d delta_d -> 0.
- Change of confinement in Section 4: D_gamma - D_1 -> 1/2 log((1+gamma x)/(gamma(1+x))), with x >= cT.
- Poisson-summation estimates for w_gamma and c_{m,delta}.
- Flat-pin lower bound (9) via precision comparison and Bayes.
- Stability lemma: the E_{i+1} recurrence, the contraction factor 3sqrt(xi)/(1-2xi) < 1 for xi < 1/64, and the backward-density bound c_i >= delta/2.
- Exterior energy (12): Green identity on the hole circles giving 2pi k log(1/rho) + 4pi^2 H_D, with an O(rho^2) correction.
- Cancellation of the nest ratio against a_n^k, and the final kernel exp(-(1/K)Σσσ G) together with the Green diagonal factors.
- Nest bounds: a_n^{-2} <= C n and the two-point bound C n/(1+r).
- Lee-Yang constants: B + Σ y^{-2} = v/4, giving E e^{tX} <= e^{t^2 v/4} and the tail bound 4e^{-r^2/(2v)}.
- Shell sums giving the box bound (d+h)^3 and the collision bound Cd.
- Integrability of the continuum domination (q = 1/4).
- Moment determinacy, and tightness in H^{-3}_loc.
I did not re-audit the companion papers C and B.
sibling_notes: The family 216 board holds two earlier no_gap_found reports. One is on the critical logarithmic correction paper (rank 95); the other is on the critical center magnetization paper (rank 104). Both flag the same residual: everything rests on companions C and B (a(b_c)=8pi, the local maps, the sector and annular kernels). That matches my finding here, so I listed the same dependence as my only, minor, item. This paper's own new machinery checked out: the positive-radius sector theorem, the annular kernel stability argument and the Lee-Yang collision removal. I posted a one-line summary to the board.
